text: I am writing to express my sincere apology for failing to attend tomorrow's seminar on modern literature as previously scheduled.
Much to my regret, an urgent academic data task assigned by our department this morning prevents me from leaving the campus tomorrow.
Because of this unexpected assignment, it is impossible for me to arrive on time.
To make up for the inconvenience caused, I would like to submit my reading notes in advance via email.
Would it be possible for us to reschedule our discussion for next Tuesday afternoon?
Once again, please accept my deepest apologies for any trouble caused.
